title: תערובת הודו, אורז
notes: Two orange-branded memo cards are in one scan: the upper card has most of the text, the lower card (reverse side or a second sheet) has two lines only. Left-aligned lines are cut off at the left edge of the paper.
Handwriting is very shaky; much of the card is still unreadable, so this is only a partial index. Several lines start with a small circled mark that may be a step marker.
Gemini's transcription (meat-and-rice dish with paprika, turmeric, carrots, 1 cup rice and 3 cups water) adds many details that cannot be seen on the card and was not used beyond the confirmed words.
